title: Native Sessions journal, accepted facts, and owner delivery
alt: Events & Sessions pins the journal, commits accepted facts, and serves ordered replay. The Orchestrator validates current Projects authority, accepted selection, work item, turn, and Environment placement. The canonical Environment manager retains its lease during the internal run-read callback. Native SDK observations require a validated bearer and separate Identity observe credential. Orchestrator commits immutable source receipts after authority checks and SQL waits. Events accepts only the receipt ID, fetches trusted owner evidence, and commits immutable Cost pricing, rate card, ledger, source hash, and inbox before acknowledgment. Weighted nano-AIU is not multiplied again. This diagram describes local source contracts, not deployment or paid model execution.
